description: Total the net weight of the loads weighed out inside a lunchtime window, where the weighbridge journal also records gross and tare and a trickle of arrivals in the same window. DISTILL-CANARY-b04e8b25

files.README.md:
# Kelsdale Wool - depot weighbridge journal

Every trailer is weighed out before it leaves. gross is the loaded trailer on
the bridge, tare the empty trailer weight recorded at the gate. Net weight is
gross minus tare.

    <time> ARRIVE trailer=<id>
    <time> WEIGH-OUT trailer=<id> gross=<n> tare=<n>
